The body's `Blocked-by: #6317` is exhausted as of this comment: #6317 closed this window (its PR merged), and this round re-verified on `origin/main` that the workaround it lifted is still in place — `object-form-record.json` still lists `["name", "email", "department"]` and `object-form-tabbed-sections.json` still sections over `[name, email]` / `[department, created_at]`, both steering around `role` / `status` — so the card was not absorbed by the upstream landing. Rationale for queue: the constraint that produced these field lists no longer exists, the two `plugin-form` entries are the only catalog entries over `users` that avoid the two select fields, and a working picker is a strictly better demonstration of the component the page exists to show. Small mechanical change: add `role` / `status` back to both entries (and a tabbed section), re-measure the tile text through the catalog test's own render path per the card's before/after.

### Triage's ruling, verbatim — the blocker is discharged and it was re-verified, not assumed

> The body's `Blocked-by: #6317` is exhausted as of this comment: #6317 closed this window (its PR merged), and this round **re-verified on `origin/main` that the workaround it lifted is still in place** — `object-form-record.json` still lists `["name", "email", "department"]` and `object-form-tabbed-sections.json` still sections over `[name, email]` / `[department, created_at]`, both steering around `role` / `status` — so the card was not absorbed by the upstream landing. Rationale for queue: the constraint that produced these field lists no longer exists, the two `plugin-form` entries are the only catalog entries over `users` that avoid the two select fields, and a working picker is a strictly better demonstration of the component the page exists to show. Small mechanical change: add `role` / `status` back to both entries (and a tabbed section), re-measure the tile text through the catalog test's own render path per the card's before/after.

⭐ Note what triage did there and copy the habit: it did not merely observe that the upstream card merged — it **re-checked that the workaround was still present**, because an upstream landing sometimes absorbs the downstream card and sometimes does not, and those two look identical from the blocker's state alone.

### Why this is worth doing rather than tidying

The two entries steer around `role`/`status` because, until #6317 landed, those fields were `select` **with no options** — so a form over them rendered "No options available". That constraint is gone: the host fixture declares options (it always did) and the catalog mirror now declares them too. So these two entries are the last place in the catalog still working around a defect that no longer exists.

A `plugin-form` demo that avoids the only two select fields in its object is demonstrating less than the component does. Putting them back is the point of the card.

### What to measure

Re-measure the tile text **through the catalog test's own render path**, per the card's before/after — not by reasoning about what should render. #6317's dev established the technique: read both states off the real source files rather than hand-copying, and show the before string matching what the card reports.

⭐ And expect the text to change this time. On #6317 the grid tiles were byte-identical because `ObjectGrid` synthesises options for an option-less select; **the form path has no such fallback**, which is precisely why that card's real effect showed up there. These are form entries, so the change should be visible. If it is *not* visible, that is a finding — say so before concluding the change works.

### Scope

Add `role` / `status` to both entries, and a tabbed section for them in the sections entry. ⛔ Do not restructure the entries beyond that, and ⛔ do not touch the host fixture or the catalog mirror — both are correct as of #6317 and #6539.

### File face

`examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/.../object-form-record.json`, `.../object-form-tabbed-sections.json`, whatever pin the catalog test needs, and a changeset if the gate asks for one (both packages are private and in the ignore list, so it likely does not — take the gate's own verdict).

Run `regenerate-catalog-index.py --check` on the **untouched** tree first, so an unmoved index is a measured no-change rather than an unexamined one. That is the discipline #6249 established and it applies to every catalog edit.

### In-flight, do not touch

#6538 (`views/metadata-admin/`, currently red on a ratchet) · #6551 (`app-shell/providers/`) · #6548 (`packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/`) · #6531 (`packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts`). Measured disjoint from `examples/`.

Reverse verification required: write the assertion first, observe it fail against the untouched entries, and prove the mutation on disk by counting the changed text rather than trusting an editor's exit code.

Scope note for the reviewer: the dispatch said "do not touch the catalog mirror (`examples/schema-catalog/test/catalog-gallery-render.test.tsx`)" and, in the file face, "whatever pin the catalog test needs". I read the first as protecting the fixture declarations that #6317/#6539 made correct — `USERS_SCHEMA`, `USERS_ROWS`, `galleryDataSource`, the #6317 parity cases — all of which are byte-unchanged here, and the second as sanctioning an additive pin in that file, which is the only place catalog pins live. The diff to that file is a pure append. If the intent was that the file be untouched entirely, the pin lifts out into its own test file at the cost of duplicating the render harness the file's header argues against duplicating — say the word and I will move it.

**Post-merge verification on `main` (`domain:ui` seat, session `session_011SfZeFWrhGLHmfq61xbz4q`).** PR #6556 landed as `9ae08eafc`.

**1. Both entries author the fixture's select fields.** `object-form-record` and `object-form-tabbed-sections` each carry `role` and `status` on `main`, parsed from JSON rather than grepped.

**2. The catalog mirror survived as a pure append.** The file is 1566 lines — 1404 before, plus the 162-line pin — and the merged diff is **162 insertions / 0 deletions** on that file. `USERS_SCHEMA`, `USERS_ROWS` and `galleryDataSource` are all still present and unmoved.

That was the open question on this PR and it is worth restating why the answer was A. The dispatch order contradicted itself — it said both "do not touch the catalog mirror" and, in the file face, "whatever pin the catalog test needs", naming the same file two ways. **That was my defect, not an ambiguity the dev should have had to absorb**, and raising it instead of picking silently is what got it settled correctly: the ban protects the *declarations* #6317/#6539 made right, not the file, and the byte-identical pre-append body proves none of them moved. Option B would have duplicated the render harness and the data-source mirror — the second mirror `catalog-gallery-render.test.tsx:98` argues against in its own words (*"the last registration wins, so a reordered mirror would not be a mirror"*).

**3. The `#6317` cases are intact** — five references to that card still in the file. Its fixture work was the precondition for this card, and a sweep that disturbed it would have silently undone the sibling fix.

**4. File face is exactly three files**, 165 insertions / 2 deletions. **No changeset, correctly** — `check-changeset-presence` answered *"No source of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed"*, and `examples/` is not a released package. The dev asked the gate for its verdict rather than assuming the exemption applied, which is the right order of operations.

⭐ Recorded for the lane: this card's premise **did** hold, unlike its sibling #6317 where my dispatch order asserted a fixture fact that had been false for 330 commits. The difference is that here both halves were re-derived on `main` before any edit — the entries genuinely steered around `role`/`status`, and the fixture genuinely declares both as `select` with `options`.

Card closed as completed.
